label: gates-04
scope: Printed elapsed times of successful named Quod cases, retaining a label across intervening test output. Sub-millisecond/unprinted timings and unlabeled rows are not assigned zero. This is one campaign, not a distribution or CPU/wait diagnosis.

all_parsed_cases.case: quod_brahms_tests: population_estimate_uses_signed_stable_identity (signed stable identities contribute to total population N)
quod_brahms_tests: graceful_leave_retires_endpoint (a signed leave removes rather than re-observes the departing endpoint)
quod_brahms_tests: outbound_endpoint_peer_is_not_split (an outbound endpoint-shaped peer retires the complete endpoint)
quod_brahms_tests: reactive_reopen (a link death with a buffered send triggers an immediate re-open)
quod_brahms_tests: probe_evicts_dead (a sampled peer that never answers a probe is evicted + its slot reset)
quod_brahms_tests: tombstone_blocks_readmission (a tombstoned dead id re-gossiped by a live peer stays out of view+sample)
quod_brahms_tests: link_error_does_not_evict (a link_error leaves the peer in view+sample and does not bump evictions)
quod_brahms_tests: idle_push_admitted (a push delivered while idle puts the pushed id into the view)
quod_brahms_tests: stale_link_peer_evicted (a dead peer with a still-alive cached link is expired then probe-evicted)
quod_brahms_tests: tombstone_refresh_keeps_dead_out (re-gossip refreshes a tombstone so a dead id stays out past tombstone_rounds)
quod_client_http_tests: -client_http_test_/0-fun-7- (health replies and keeps the connection)
quod_client_http_tests: -client_http_test_/0-fun-6- (an API reply does not crash its request process)
quod_client_http_tests: -client_http_test_/0-fun-5- (every route honours the handler contract)
quod_client_http_tests: -client_http_test_/0-fun-1- (group selectors are bounded and retain signed session admission)
quod_client_http_tests: -client_http_test_/0-fun-0- (sampled HTTP parent reaches the signed request span)
quod_names_tests: -saltless_draw_test_/0-fun-19- (different proofs can draw different names)
